summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Document Management enhancements for iteration 12. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: Upload & Map redesign with mode toggle (Map to Framework / General Upload), category selector, custom tags input, expanded file type support. Document Library with category filter, click-to-view for both uploaded documents and generated policies. DocumentDetailPanel with edit mode, custom labels with auto-suggest, framework control tags.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - React hydration warning in select dropdowns. This is a minor cosmetic issue that doesn't affect functionality.

seed_data_creation: Used existing uploaded document (sample_security_policy.pdf) with custom_tags ['Annual Review', 'Q1 Audit'] and category 'evidence'. Also used existing generated policies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Document Management enhancements fully implemented and tested. Key features: (1) Upload & Map has mode toggle - 'Map to Framework' shows framework selector, 'General Upload' hides it. Both modes have category selector and custom tags input. (2) Document Library has category filter dropdown, type filter, status filter. Clicking uploaded doc opens DocumentDetailPanel, clicking generated policy opens PolicyViewer with approval bar. (3) DocumentDetailPanel has Edit button that reveals category selector and description input. Custom Labels section allows add/remove freeform labels with auto-suggest from previously used tags. Framework Control Tags section allows linking to framework controls. Key endpoints: GET /api/documents (returns filename, job_id fields), GET /api/documents/custom-tags (returns unique tags for auto-suggest), PUT /api/documents/{id}/metadata (updates category, custom_tags, description).
